nom: STARFACE Hydro-Star Extra Small Pimple Patches

avis.texte: They're perfect! Small enough that they aren't floppy or wrinkled, and they stick great! Would love it if they came in an all yellow pack. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

As someone with multiple little blemishes far away from each other, the mini stars are perfect to get these and not feel like you're wasting a bigger sticker! Plus, this set of colours is my absolute favourite so far. I would buy the regular size and big sizes in this colour set too if made available ;o Excellent quality as always, stick well even through exercise!

avis.titre: Don't think twice just buy it already!
avis.texte: So amazing! I've had acne and scarring problems for years and these are the first products to actually help my skin and help it FAST! 10/10 recommend all of it from recovery patches, moisturizer, face wash and the rest of the products are 100% worth every penny. My only regret is not finding this company sooner
Does the job decently. Really cute for covering up small blemishes that don't require the regular sized stars.
Adorable for the smaller blemishes and still work just as well!

avis.titre: Adorable and perfect for small spots!
avis.texte: These tiny stars are an absolute must-have for those small, annoying little whiteheads. Sometimes the regular stars feel a bit too big for tiny spots, so this smaller size is incredibly convenient and fits perfectly. The mix of colors is extra cute, and they still do an amazing job of flattening out the pimples overnight!
I'm loving Tiny Star! They're perfect for small pimples, they look beautiful, and they're still the most effective. Plus, the color selection couldn't be better because they go with all my outfits!
The perfect size! So cute, many colors to choose from. Now I don't feel sad when I get pimples, cuz I get to put stars on my face.
LOVED THESE LIL STARS! SHARED THEM WITH MY LIL COUSIN WHO INTEODUCED US!

These size of these were crazy small lol, super convenient for those pesky small pimples in the corner of your nose. The only color I didn't like in the pack was the black one, people kept saying they thought I had marker or food on my face lol
i adore starface and wear them all the time. they work so well and look super duper cute. i missed the chance to get the tiny stars and am absolutely heartbroken!! PLEASE RESTOCK!! < 3
exactly what i orderd and the packaging was also really cute 😄

and they come with like 50 something in the package!! all kinds of super cute colors; yellow, pink, blue, purple, green and black! i'm personally dying for an all black mini series BUT I'm loyal and patient :satisfied:
